WritableKey.description: Server rejects platform. and mlflow. prefixes case-insensitively, and reserved run/experiment/job/tenant/user/owner/artifact/provenance/status/time identifiers.

value.description: Finite JSON number; NaN and Infinity are rejected.
At most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; an empty string is valid.
At most 5000 UTF-8 bytes; an empty string is valid.

run_uuid.description: Optional legacy alias; when supplied must equal run_id. Both are RayTrain platform IDs.

MLflowSDKLogBatchRequest.description: At most 256 KiB of strict JSON; duplicate or case-variant schema fields and non-finite numbers are rejected. At least one array must be nonempty. Parameter and tag keys must be unique within each array. Writes are not atomic and must not be retried blindly.

value.description: At most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; an empty string is valid.
At most 5000 UTF-8 bytes; an empty string is valid.

MLflowSDKUpdateRequest.description: Only terminal states are accepted. end_time must be at least the stored run start time. The first durable finish intent retains its end_time on retry; omission uses server time. A completed run cannot be reopened.

latestMetrics.description: Latest tuples from upstream runs/get, at most 20 keys. Missing or invalid timestamp/step metadata is omitted, never fabricated; legacy latest values remain available.

tags.description: Safe custom tags, sorted by key and limited to 100. Reserved platform/MLflow/internal/credential names are excluded. Values are UTF-8 and at most 5000 bytes; this is not a full native tag mirror.

bearerPAT.description: RayTrain PAT. Read requires experiments:read. Writes require experiments:read and experiments:write.
